rev.t: For people of the 80’s and 90’s, Rex theatre was a place frequently visited with friends and family for catching up on the latest movies…Forum Rex Walk, the completely upgraded building is a place of class, vibes and gourmet bites! …

Great movie watching experience at PVR Rex. The sound quality and ambience was excellent, air conditioning was just about perfect. The restrooms were super clean. The support staff in all areas were friendly and respectful. …
Forum Rex Walk is a great spot to hang out, especially if you enjoy a mix of good food, cafés, and a lively city vibe. …
